name: Get Fat And Roll Race
desc:
Welcome to Get Fat And Roll Race! How far can you roll?

How to Play:
🍔 Eat food to gain weight and roll faster!
🐾 Collect various pets that help you gather more food!
🏆 Roll down the hill and aim for the greatest distance covered!

Premium Players: +20% grow speed & +10% roll speed 🚀
Got lag? Use a FREE VIP Server 👍
